messages:
Harper: CS escalation — OrbitLabs reports p99 jump from ~350ms to ~1.9s on streaming /v1/generate (orbit-16k) starting 2024-11-03T01:14:03Z. Trace attached shows long memcpy inside attention kernel.

Tao (eng-sre): Looking. Recent runtime push toggled flashattn_v2 and SDPA tile heuristics at 00:50 UTC. deploy-bot, paste the diff please.

deploy-bot: rollout/runtime-attn-2024-11-03
- ENABLE_FLASHATTN=true
- SDPA_TILE_PREFER=64
- COMPILE_FLAGS=-O3-DUSE_FLASHATTN=1
Canary finished 00:59 UTC.

Nina (eng-ml): Microbench on similar HW (nvidia driver 535):
```
model: orbit-16k
seq: 12288
flashattn_v2: p99 1900ms
flashattn_v1: p99 420ms
sdpa_tile_64: p99 1600ms
matmul-path: p99 380ms
```
Behavior: flashattn_v2 selects a tiled path but emits 'fallback_to_emulated' for certain alignments -> huge memcpy.

Kofi (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigation: apply per-route override to force attention=matmul and sdpa_tile=32 for route orbit-prod-us-east. Will canary at 5%.

Tao: Applied override via control-plane at 01:20 UTC. Canary=5%.

metrics-bot: p99 for OrbitLabs route dropped from 1.89s -> 0.46s within 3m. p95 from 580ms -> 150ms.

CS-Liam: OrbitLabs confirmed SLA restored. They want RCA and timeline to fully enable flashattn safely.

Nina: Root cause hypothesis: flashattn_v2 introduced an optimized tiled kernel which assumes specific memory alignment/stride. On driver 535 and when inputs are padded to 4096 boundaries it triggers a fallback code path that performs O(n^2) memcpy/copy with scalar loops, causing tail latency blowup. SDPA_TILE=64 increases selector probability into that path.

Kofi: Action items:
- PR#5133: Disable default ENABLE_FLASHATTN until gating logic is added.
- PR#5134: Add driver+sm gating: only enable flashattn_v2 for driver >= 536 and sm >= 8.0.
- PR#5135: Add kernel_fallback_count metric per model/node and an alert if >0.2% of reqs in 5m.
- PR#5136: Add CI integration tests for 8k/12k/16k sequences on driver matrix (535/536/540).

Tao: Ops additions:
- Add runbook entry 'attn_kernel_fallback' describing overrides and verification steps.
- Auto-mitigation rule: if p99 > 800ms AND kernel_fallback_count > 10 in 5m, auto-set route override to matmul.

Nina: Repro steps for eng-runtime:
1) checkout runtime branch attn-fallback-debug
2) build with COMPILE_FLAGS=-O3-DUSE_FLASHATTN=1
3) run bench: ci/bench/attention.sh --model orbit-16k --seq 12288 --gpu=local:0
Look for logs:
[INFO] kernel selected: flashattn_v2
[WARN] fallback_to_emulated: alignment mismatch
[DEBUG] emulated memcpy bytes=... latency=1800ms

Kofi: I'll keep override in place until PRs land and we complete canary on driver 536 nodes. ETA gating: 3 days; CI matrix: 7 days.

Harper: I'll update ticket ORBIT-9001 with timeline and send customer note. We'll follow up with a postmortem in 48h.

ops-bot: PRs opened: runtime#5133, runtime#5134, runtime#5135, runtime#5136.

Participants: Harper, Tao, Nina, Kofi, deploy-bot, metrics-bot, ops-bot, CS-Liam
